name: Clash Distribution
purpose: Package the CLI, stdio MCP surface, skills, and internal local-api host as the single installable clash npm package.
runtimeBoundary: The clash dispatcher selects the CLI for ordinary arguments and the peer stdio MCP for `clash mcp`. Both use one discoverable local-api daemon. Discovery includes the content fingerprint of the host artifact: compatible clients reuse that exact daemon, while a superseded artifact is retired under the single startup lock before its replacement publishes discovery. MCP keeps a fixed `clash_plugin` dispatcher whose live operations author drafts in the Agent working tree and manage activated packages through that discovered Host; plugin activation never creates a second daemon or dynamic MCP tool list. Desktop carries the same host runtime and reuses the compatible machine singleton; client or Desktop shutdown does not stop the shared daemon. Source-host file watching is explicit development behavior, not the daemon default. The distribution carries a closed set of immutable first-party plugin payloads that the Host imports in-process; only explicitly activated third-party packages use the actions-directory process/stdio realm.
